name: portfolio-atlas-fintech-portfolio-manager
description: Build an open-source portfolio manager with React, TypeScript, Yahoo Finance and fintech-algorithms: a chapter-by-chapter educational project.
author: Islam Baraka / The Fintech Builder

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run docs:check
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @portfolio-atlas/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently --kill-others -n types,api,web "tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev --workspace @portfolio-atlas/api" "npm run dev --workspace @portfolio-atlas/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:server && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:server && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
